'''Lana''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3956 BBY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], she was tricked by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Jergan]], who promised Lana to arrange a backstage meeting with the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Band/Legends|band]] in the [[Upper City Cantina]] for a fee of twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Biography==
Lana was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Upper City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]<ref name="KotOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="CG">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the woman had come in contact with [[Jergan]], a Human visitor of the [[Upper City Cantina]] on Taris who promised to arrange backstage meetings with the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Band/Legends|band]] playing there. Lana gave him twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], believing his story and unaware that he was actually a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]]. Jergan disappeared with the credits, leaving Lana to check the backstage for him, but found that no one there knew who he was. Angered, Lana started looking for Jergan, hoping to reclaim the lost [[Currency/Legends|money]], with interest.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Personality and traits==
Lana was a [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] woman with green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin. She was very angered by Jergan's actions and was determined to find the con artist and make him return the money.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Equipment==
While on Taris, the woman wore a tan [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]] with green trim over a green-collared shirt with tan sleeves, tan pants, and gray [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. Lana also wore with the outfit a tan [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with one pouch and black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]].<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You fell for his story too? Well I got some bad news for you sister&mdash;he ain't coming back. I gave him 20 credits last week, and he just disappeared with it!|Lana, in a non-canon conversation with a female Revan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
Lana appeared in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. The character's name is only mentioned in dialogue, as when the player targets them, the game identifies them as "Angry Woman." Lana only appears in the game if the player character is female and has fallen for Jergan's scheme as well. Witnessing Jergan running off with Revan's money, Lana reveals that they have been tricked by him a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] earlier and asks the player if she knows where Jergan went.<ref name="KotOR" /> However, as Revan has since been established as male in later sources,<ref name="TOR:Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> Lana is never encountered in the game's walkthrough [[canon]]ically<ref name="KotOR" /> with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref>
